repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.one_liner: A highly optimized C99 implementation capable of running a 2.78-trillion-parameter model inference on a single CPU with minimal RAM.
bullets: Tech Structure: Pure C99 implementation with zero dependencies on BLAS, GPU frameworks, or external libraries.
Purpose: Demonstrates extreme hardware efficiency by running massive-scale models on standard consumer CPUs.
Use Cases: Ideal for edge computing, local privacy-focused inference, and reducing cloud infrastructure costs for large-scale model deployment.

repos.name: FedericoTs/quantprobe
repos.description: Run a 110B on a 2016 PC with 16 GB RAM. Know your tok/s before you download. Placement beats budget: predicts speed + memory fit for any GGUF on your exact hardware, self-calibrates, emits the exact llama.cpp command — or 'quantprobe auto' does it all. Falsification-tested laws; misses published at full size. pip install quantprobe
repos.one_liner: A diagnostic tool that predicts inference speed and memory fit for GGUF models on specific hardware configurations.
bullets: Tech Structure: Python-based benchmarking utility that self-calibrates against local hardware specs.
Purpose: Eliminates the guesswork in model deployment by calculating exact token-per-second performance before downloading large weights.
Use Cases: Essential for quant researchers and infrastructure engineers optimizing LLM serving costs on heterogeneous hardware.

repos.name: opensible/opensible
repos.description: An open source GitOps control plane for OpenTofu & Ansible - provision, configure and deploy across cloud, on-prem and hybrid, self-hosted and forever free.
repos.one_liner: An open-source GitOps control plane designed to unify OpenTofu and Ansible for hybrid cloud infrastructure management.
bullets: Tech Structure: Python-based orchestration engine providing a centralized control plane for infrastructure-as-code.
Purpose: Bridges the gap between provisioning (OpenTofu) and configuration management (Ansible) in a single GitOps workflow.
Use Cases: Automating complex multi-cloud deployments, enforcing infrastructure compliance, and managing on-premise to cloud migrations.

repos.name: YizhiSong/FriesTrader
repos.description: A fully automated AI trading agent that trades real Robinhood orders via its Agentic Trading MCP under mechanical, auditable risk rules the model cannot override. Once set up, it is able to run on its own schedule, screening and trading stocks under a narrow, explicit gate. Cheap to run — Claude Pro only, no metered API spend. Not financial advice.
repos.one_liner: A fully automated AI trading agent that executes real Robinhood orders via an Agentic Trading MCP with hard-coded, immutable risk constraints.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based agentic framework utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for secure tool integration.
Purpose: To bridge the gap between autonomous AI decision-making and strict, auditable financial risk management.
Use Cases: Automated execution of trading strategies where the model's logic is constrained by non-overrideable safety rules.
Key Feature: Implements a 'mechanical' risk layer that prevents the AI from violating predefined capital protection parameters.

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.one_liner: A highly optimized inference engine enabling Gemma 4 26B-A4B models to run on standard M-series MacBooks using only 2 GB of RAM.
bullets: Tech Stack: Written in Swift, leveraging low-level memory management and hardware-specific optimizations for Apple Silicon.
Purpose: To democratize access to high-parameter LLMs by drastically reducing the hardware requirements for local inference.
Use Cases: Running sophisticated AI models on consumer-grade laptops without cloud dependency or massive memory overhead.
Key Feature: Achieves extreme memory efficiency, allowing large-scale model deployment on devices previously considered incapable.
repos.img_alt: TurboFieldfare Mac app generating text with Gemma 4 26B-A4B

repos.name: crabbuild/compass
repos.description: Native, local-first knowledge graph engine for code and project artifacts—inspired by Graphify, built in Rust, and evolving beyond it.
repos.one_liner: A native, local-first knowledge graph engine built in Rust for indexing and navigating complex codebases and project artifacts.
bullets: Tech Stack: Built in Rust for high-performance memory safety and concurrency, utilizing a local-first storage architecture.
Purpose: To provide developers with a structured, queryable map of their project's internal logic and dependencies.
Use Cases: Large-scale codebase navigation, automated documentation generation, and identifying architectural bottlenecks.
Key Feature: Offers a persistent, searchable graph representation of code that evolves alongside the project, outperforming traditional grep-based tools.
repos.img_alt: High-level Compass workspace graph with package dependencies and subsystem filters

repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local dashboard designed to ingest logs from Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI agents.
Purpose: Provides granular visibility into agentic workflows by tracking token consumption, latency, and financial costs per task.
Use Cases: Ideal for developers and finance teams needing to audit AI ROI, debug agent tool usage, and monitor spend on automated coding tasks.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure tool for multimodal time-series data, built as a high-performance fork of Rerun.
